items.title: Power and heat history
items.text: Day, Week and Month charts of power draw and heat, with peaks and the energy used and its cost. Roost keeps about 90 days in a tiny file, written once an hour.

items.title: Heads-up before a drive fails
items.text: Roost now watches each drive's trend. It warns you on the bell and your phone when a drive starts losing sectors, an SSD is wearing out within a year, or a drive stays hot for half an hour. Drive cards show about how many years an SSD has left.
